pected-vs-actual tool call analysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may evolve. Treat it as an open document. Returns `404` with

th `status` (`ok`/`fail`/`skipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls
). The fastest way to see which step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404`: step verdicts still retu…\n-

ancelled` with no verdict, which is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run is alread…\n- [Pr
